name: Serve-Ready Check
model: Maturity/readiness — reduced from 68 items / 12 domains to 30 items / 6 serving domains
instruction: Answer based on your real, consistent pattern of life — not your best day, not your ideal self. Be honest before God.
reverse_scoring: Items marked R are scored 6 minus response.

output.per_domain: STRONG / DEVELOPING / ATTENTION label per domain
output.pastoral_flag: Raised when Confidentiality or Submission domain < 60% (conversation required)

CI.name: Character & Integrity
items: I keep my word even when it costs me something.
I am the same person in private that I am in public.
I tell the truth even when a small lie would be easier.
When I make a mistake, I own it rather than cover it.
R: I bend the rules when I think no one will notice.

HT.name: Humility & Teachability
items: I accept correction without becoming defensive.
I am quick to say 'I was wrong' when I am.
I actively ask others for feedback on how I serve.
I value other people's input above my own preferences.
R: I struggle to take instruction from people younger or less experienced than me.

RF.name: Reliability & Faithfulness
items: I arrive on time and ready for what I have committed to.
I finish what I start, even the unseen tasks.
People can depend on me to do what I said I would.
I show up consistently, not only when I feel like it.
R: I often cancel or drop commitments at the last minute.

CD.name: Confidentiality & Discretion
items: I keep private matters private, even from close friends.
I can be trusted with sensitive information.
I handle other people's struggles quietly and with care.
I resist the urge to share news that isn't mine to share.
R: I find it hard not to repeat something interesting I have heard.

SA.name: Submission to Authority
items: I willingly follow the leaders God has placed over me.
I support a decision once it is made, even if I disagreed.
I honour those in charge rather than undermine them.
I raise concerns respectfully and through the right channel.
R: I do things my own way even when I have been asked not to.

ES.name: Emotional Steadiness
items: I stay calm when situations become tense or chaotic.
I control my reactions rather than let my emotions lead.
Under pressure, others would describe me as steady.
I recover quickly when things do not go as planned.
R: I get flustered or short-tempered when things go wrong.
